crossRefs.note: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
“ ‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals…
I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord Yahweh.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.
The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains.…
But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like…
For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

translations.web: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
translations.bsb: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
translations.kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
translations.asv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
